market_mood.explanation_en: The 71.3 score is like a river with steady current but hidden rocks — enough momentum to move forward but distribution days mean you should watch your step before jumping in. For someone deciding whether to buy stocks today, it suggests selective buying is reasonable but avoid broad exposure until breadth improves.
